properties.value: Provisional persona quality, category breakdowns and demographic-adjusted scores for 172 Lund park polygons.
demographic_priority_points: higher = more priority; demographic_adjusted_index: lower = more priority

The category scores are the existing shared category measures; persona profiles differ by their category weights. Young accessibility is available for the spider chart but has zero weight in its overall score.
Coverage is the proportion of intended evidence available. All quality and demographic scores are provisional; mapped zero is not verified absence. Unknown values are null.

value.distance: straight-line from population-cell centre to park polygon

formulas.unmet_need_points: sum of the three group gap contributions; larger = greater priority

limitations: DeSO age shares are neighbourhood averages, not observed individual ages in each grid cell
Age 0–14 approximates the family persona; age 15–29 approximates the student/young persona; age 65+ approximates the senior/wheelchair persona, and does not identify wheelchair users
Other age groups do not contribute to the gap; this is not overall quality or evidence of need among them
Population in overlapping park catchments is counted for each park; catchment population is limited to the urban study boundary
Park scores are provisional; group shares and population do not identify park users, travel routes, barriers or actual access
All three group contributions are equally valued per percentage point of population; smaller groups may still have important needs

properties.value: DeSO average ages are estimates for nearby cells; 0–14 approximates family, 15–29 approximates young, and 65+ approximates pensioner, not disability. 30–64 is not evaluated. Straight-line catchments can overlap and do not establish access or actual park use.
